items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: And Tommy and I roomed together, the whole time

ctx.x: Because Tommy was very independent type of man and he wouldn't stand for any foolishness, you know. Sam was taking -- you know, he had his way because he was underpaying me and I knew that's why I left him in Hamburg. I was doing all that playing, lead trumpet in the band and I learned that he was paying me so much under what he was paying the rest of the guys, I quit. Berlin, when he came and picked me up then he raised my salary. But Tommy I thought was one of the greatest trumpet players -- I could dig him…
we were in the band up until the time just before he left Sam in Nice. He left Sam in Nice.
